      "text": "This HTML file creates a real-time, interactive simulation of the ferrofluid in your image using WebGL (Three.js).\n\n### **Instructions**\n1.  Copy the code below.\n2.  Save it as an `.html` file (e.g., `ferrofluid.html`).\n3.  Open it in any modern web browser.\n4.  **Interact:** Move your mouse to drag the \"magnet\" and create the spike formations.\n\n```html\n\u003c!DOCTYPE html\u003e\n\u003chtml lang\u003d\"en\"\u003e\n\u003chead\u003e\n    \u003cmeta charset\u003d\"UTF-8\"\u003e\n    \u003ctitle\u003eFerrofluid Simulation\u003c/title\u003e\n    \u003cstyle\u003e\n        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background-color: #e0e0e0; }\n        canvas { display: block; }\n        #instruction {\n            position: absolute;\n            top: 20px;\n            width: 100%;\n            text-align: center;\n            color: #333;\n            font-family: sans-serif;\n            font-weight: bold;\n            pointer-events: none;\n            text-transform: uppercase;\n            letter-spacing: 2px;\n        }\n    \u003c/style\u003e\n\u003c/head\u003e\n\u003cbody\u003e\n    \u003cdiv id\u003d\"instruction\"\u003eMove Mouse to Control Magnet\u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c!-- Import Three.js --\u003e\n    \u003cscript type\u003d\"module\"\u003e\n        import * as THREE from \u0027https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js\u0027;\n\n        // 1. SCENE SETUP\n        const scene \u003d new THREE.Scene();\n        scene.background \u003d new THREE.Color(0xe0e0e0); // Matches the white/grey studio background\n        scene.fog \u003d new THREE.Fog(0xe0e0e0, 10, 50);\n\n        const camera \u003d new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);\n        camera.position.set(0, 12, 18);\n        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);\n\n        const renderer \u003d new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });\n        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n        renderer.shadowMap.enabled \u003d true;\n        renderer.shadowMap.type \u003d THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;\n        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);\n\n        // 2. LIGHTING (Crucial for the glossy black look)\n        const ambientLight \u003d new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.4);\n        scene.add(ambientLight);\n\n        // Main directional light (The \"Studio\" light)\n        const dirLight \u003d new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2);\n        dirLight.position.set(5, 10, 5);\n        dirLight.castShadow \u003d true;\n        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.width \u003d 1024;\n        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.height \u003d 1024;\n        scene.add(dirLight);\n\n        // Rim light for highlights\n        const spotLight \u003d new THREE.SpotLight(0xffffff, 10);\n        spotLight.position.set(-5, 5, -5);\n        scene.add(spotLight);\n\n        // 3. FERROFLUID MESH\n        // High resolution plane to allow detailed vertex manipulation\n        const geometry \u003d new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 20, 150, 150);\n        \n        // Rotated to lay flat\n        geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);\n\n        // Glossy Black Material\n        const material \u003d new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({\n            color: 0x050505,       // Almost black\n            roughness: 0.1,        // Very smooth\n            metalness: 0.7,        // Metallic\n            flatShading: false,\n        });\n\n        const fluid \u003d new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);\n        fluid.castShadow \u003d true;\n        fluid.receiveShadow \u003d true;\n        scene.add(fluid);\n\n        // Store original positions to calculate displacement\n        const positionAttribute \u003d geometry.attributes.position;\n        const vertex \u003d new THREE.Vector3();\n        const basePositions \u003d [];\n        for (let i \u003d 0; i \u003c positionAttribute.count; i++) {\n            vertex.fromBufferAttribute(positionAttribute, i);\n            basePositions.push({ x: vertex.x, y: vertex.y, z: vertex.z });\n        }\n\n        // 4. SIMULATION LOGIC\n        const mouse \u003d new THREE.Vector2();\n        const target \u003d new THREE.Vector2();\n        const raycaster \u003d new THREE.Raycaster();\n        const plane \u003d new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);\n        \n        // Mouse interaction\n        window.addEventListener(\u0027mousemove\u0027, (event) \u003d\u003e {\n            mouse.x \u003d (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;\n            mouse.y \u003d -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;\n        });\n\n        // Parameters\n        const MOUND_RADIUS \u003d 6.0;\n        const MOUND_HEIGHT \u003d 3.5;\n        const SPIKE_FREQ \u003d 2.5; \n        const TIME_SCALE \u003d 0.003;\n\n        function updateFluid(time) {\n            // Find where mouse intersects the floor plane\n            raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);\n            const intersection \u003d new THREE.Vector3();\n            raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, intersection);\n            \n            // Smoothly interpolate the \"magnet\" position\n            if (intersection) {\n                target.x +\u003d (intersection.x - target.x) * 0.1;\n                target.y +\u003d (intersection.z - target.y) * 0.1; // Z matches Y in 2D logic\n            }\n\n            const positions \u003d fluid.geometry.attributes.position.array;\n\n            for (let i \u003d 0; i \u003c basePositions.length; i++) {\n                const bx \u003d basePositions[i].x;\n                const by \u003d basePositions[i].y; // This is Z in world space\n                \n                // Calculate distance from the magnet center\n                const dx \u003d bx - target.x;\n                const dy \u003d by - target.y;\n                const dist \u003d Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n\n                // Calculate the \"Mound\" shape (Gaussian falloff)\n                // Only lift vertices within the radius\n                let height \u003d 0;\n                if (dist \u003c MOUND_RADIUS) {\n                    const falloff \u003d Math.max(0, 1 - (dist / MOUND_RADIUS));\n                    const smoothedFalloff \u003d falloff * falloff * (3 - 2 * falloff); // Smoothstep curve\n                    \n                    // Base mound shape\n                    const baseShape \u003d smoothedFalloff * MOUND_HEIGHT;\n\n                    // Spike Pattern (Rosensweig instability approximation)\n                    // Uses Sine waves modulated by the mound height\n                    const spikePattern \u003d Math.sin(bx * SPIKE_FREQ * 2) * Math.cos(by * SPIKE_FREQ * 2);\n                    const secondarySpike \u003d Math.sin(bx * SPIKE_FREQ + time) * Math.cos(by * SPIKE_FREQ + time);\n                    \n                    // Spikes are sharper near the top (center of magnet)\n                    const spikeHeight \u003d (spikePattern + secondarySpike * 0.5) * smoothedFalloff * 1.2;\n                    \n                    // Combine mound + spikes. \n                    // Use Math.abs on spikes to make them sharp points pointing up\n                    height \u003d baseShape + Math.max(0, spikeHeight);\n                }\n\n                // Update Y position (Up in Three.js)\n                // The geometry index for Y is i * 3 + 1\n                positions[i * 3 + 1] \u003d height; \n            }\n\n            fluid.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate \u003d true;\n            fluid.geometry.computeVertexNormals(); // Essential for lighting to look correct on deformation\n        }\n\n        // 5. RENDER LOOP\n        function animate(time) {\n            requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n            updateFluid(time * TIME_SCALE);\n            renderer.render(scene, camera);\n        }\n\n        animate(0);\n\n        // Handle Resize\n        window.addEventListener(\u0027resize\u0027, () \u003d\u003e {\n            camera.aspect \u003d window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;\n            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);\n        });\n\n    \u003c/script\u003e\n\u003c/body\u003e\n\u003c/html\u003e\n```",
